# Alliance of Coders

> The official website of the Alliance of Coders (AOC) at Cebu Technological University - Danao Campus. A community of developers, innovators, and tech leaders united by code.

Alliance of Coders (AoC) is a student tech organization at Cebu Technological University - Danao Campus. This website serves as the official portal for announcements, officer rosters, and public contact.

## Public content (suitable for LLM indexing)

- [Home / Announcements](https://ctu-alliance-of-coders.vercel.app): Latest news, awards, recognitions, and reports. Announcements may include specialized links (registration forms, event pages, resources).
- [Officers](https://ctu-alliance-of-coders.vercel.app): Leadership roster by academic year, with org-chart view. Officers include name, role, and photo.
- [Contact](https://ctu-alliance-of-coders.vercel.app): Public contact form for membership, events, technical support, and partnership inquiries.
- [FAQ](https://ctu-alliance-of-coders.vercel.app): Frequently asked questions about the organization.
- [Privacy Policy](https://ctu-alliance-of-coders.vercel.app): What we collect and how we use it.
- [Data Protection](https://ctu-alliance-of-coders.vercel.app): How we protect stored data.
- [Terms of Use](https://ctu-alliance-of-coders.vercel.app): Using this site.
- [Cookie Policy](https://ctu-alliance-of-coders.vercel.app): How we use local storage.

## Content NOT for indexing

- `/api/*` — all API endpoints (admin-only, PII, auth surfaces). Disallowed in robots.txt.
- Admin panel content — requires authentication, not public.
- Individual contact messages — PII, admin-only.

## Summary facts

- Organization: Alliance of Coders
- Campus: Cebu Technological University - Danao Campus
- Location: Danao City, Cebu, Philippines
- Founded: student tech organization
- Language: English
- Tech stack: Next.js 16, TypeScript, Prisma 7, Supabase (PostgreSQL + Storage)

## AI scraping policy

See [ai.txt](https://ctu-alliance-of-coders.vercel.app/ai.txt) for the full AI scraping policy. Summary:
- Allowed: summarizing public announcements, answering questions about the org, citing the org
- Not allowed: scraping admin content, storing PII, bypassing rate limits, impersonating the org
- Attribution: cite "Alliance of Coders" and link to the source page
